title: Thieves Steal Trailers, Find 20 Tons of Sand Inside
summary:
Imagine stealing a trailer full of treasure—and finding only sand. That's what happened to some thieves in California last Thursday.

Two trailers with logos for PlusAI and Nvidia were parked outside a warehouse in Newark, California. Nvidia is the most valuable company in the world, so the thieves probably thought they were getting valuable computer chips. They hooked up their own truck cabs and drove away.

But when they broke open the trailers, they found about 20,000 pounds of sand in each one—40,000 pounds total! PlusAI uses sand as a simulated load for testing self-driving trucks. The real truck cabs, where drivers sit, were safely inside the warehouse and weren't taken.

The trailers were soon found and returned to PlusAI. The police are still investigating, and no arrests have been made. This story has a happy ending for the company—and a funny one for the thieves, who ended up with nothing but sand.
why_it_matters: This story shows that what looks valuable from the outside isn't always valuable inside — and that companies test new machines carefully before trusting them on real roads.

background_read: Nvidia is a company that makes computer chips — the tiny 'brains' inside computers and robots — and its chips are so wanted for AI that it has become one of the most valuable companies in the world.
PlusAI is a company building self-driving trucks. Before such trucks carry real goods, engineers test them with heavy loads, and sometimes they just use sand.
Stealing cargo is a real crime: thieves sometimes follow trailers leaving warehouses because the electronics inside are worth a lot of money and easy to sell.
Article_Structure: WHO: Thieves in California who stole two trailers, and the police who are still investigating with no arrests made.
WHAT: The thieves took trailers full of nothing but about 20,000 pounds of sand each — 40,000 pounds in total.
WHERE: Outside a warehouse in Newark, California, while the real truck cabs stayed safely inside the building.
WHY: The trailers had PlusAI and Nvidia logos, so the thieves expected valuable computer chips, but PlusAI had loaded them with sand for testing self-driving trucks.

perspectives.description: They came out of this well: the trailers were found and returned, and no chips were ever stolen.
They took a big risk for nothing at all, ending up with only sand instead of the treasure they expected.
They still have work to do, because the people who took the trailers have not been caught, and stealing cargo can be dangerous for drivers.
